fields.Name: T098 - Entity Form Email and URL Field Link Rendering
fields.Description: Covers the LinkType='Email'/'URL' read-mode rendering branches (OnEmailLinkClick/OnUrlLinkClick with mailto/external-link icons) — distinct from LinkType='Record' FK links (T214) and from FK display-name rendering (T92).

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Members', click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Open a member row, then 'Open Full Record' to view it in read mode. Locate an email-typed field (e.g. Email) or a URL/website-typed field. When such a field HAS a value it should render as a styled clickable hyperlink — an email with an envelope icon (mailto) or a URL with an external-link arrow icon — rather than as plain text. Success is at least one populated email- or URL-typed field rendering as a styled link with the appropriate icon; if every such field on the record is empty, seeing the read-mode form render cleanly with those fields shown as empty is an acceptable pass.

judgeValidationCriteria: A populated email field renders as a clickable link with an envelope icon, OR a populated URL field renders as a link with an external-link icon
The linkified value is presented as a styled hyperlink not plain unstyled text (OR all email/URL fields on the record are empty and render cleanly)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
